zuust20t25_20260827.t20_why: The interesting half is that the decision layer is blind to BOTH sides, which is what demotes t20 to a combat-power call. [5] is the ONLY talent in the focus five whose payoff lands on a KV key its own file already queries: the engine folds it into `arc_damage` and X.ConsiderQ reads exactly that key at hero_zuus.lua:594 (post-edit line numbers shifted). But that read has exactly ONE consumer -- the J.WillKillTarget creep test -- and the consumer sits behind `bot:GetActiveMode() == BOT_MODE_LANING`. The fold is reachable at level 20 and the door it arrives at is not: laning is long over. Direction is benign (the engine still applies the +60; the bot merely under-rates its own Arc, and only in lane, where the talent does not exist). [6] folds into `ministun_duration`, which NO site in the repo reads. Tie broken on volume and rank: Arc is maxed by BOTH rows of tAllAbilityBuildList, costs 85-100 on a 1.6s cooldown, is bid from nine branches of X.ConsiderQ, and the +60 is paid PER JUMP (180 -> 240 at the rank held, +33%). [6] buys 0.35 -> 0.85s of ministun on an ability whose 0.35 already interrupts channels and teleports; the extra 0.5s is chase-and-kite time this file has no code to convert (X.ConsiderE is the only mobility branch and never sequences off a stun).
zuust20t25_20260827.t25_why: This one IS a decision-layer ruling, and it is the mirror image of the Lion row priced at 05:30Z. hero_zuus.lua reads `talent7:IsTrained()` inside X.SkillsComplement to swap ActionQueue_UseAbilityOnEntity for ActionQueue_UseAbilityOnLocation, and index 7 really IS the AoE talent -- so this is the WORKING twin of the wiring GH #166 found BROKEN on Lion (same idiom, index 8, applied to a UNIT_TARGET Hex). Point-casting the bolt is legal with or without the talent (the base ability carries spread_aoe = 325, already verified at the X.ConsiderW2 site), so the talent upgrades 'strike one unit near the point' into 'strike every unit near the point'. Taking [8] would freeze `talent7:IsTrained()` false for the whole game and turn the only place in this file where a talent changes an ORDER into dead code. [8]'s honest merit, recorded rather than buried: its payoff needs NO decision-layer support at all, since AbilityCharges is spent through the `IsFullyCastable` test X.ConsiderE already gates on. It loses on volume -- W is bid from nine branches across X.ConsiderW and X.ConsiderW2, E from two.

fieldsrc_ff_PREMISE_20260904.legislative: A PARTITION CAN BE COMPLETE AT THE PREDICATE AND WRONG ON BOTH SIDES IN THE WORLD. stayfield/stayfield2 and fieldbuy partition the situation exactly -- fieldbuy reads `not (HasFieldRegenSource and IsFieldSipEnough)`, the same conjunction negated, so no frame is owned by neither and none by both. That completeness is a property of the PREDICATE. What neither side asks is whether the field it partitions on is consumable downstream: on these 7 frames hold=TRUE means 'held with an item it cannot eat' and buy=FALSE means 'already supplied', and both are wrong at once. Same coin as campbind_20260904 (a selector's value is the part downstream consumes) -- there the vetoes were undone by a downstream 'nearest', here the presence is asserted by an upstream slot read that no consumer honours.
fieldsrc_ff_PREMISE_20260904.why_nobody_has_seen_it: 'fieldsip' (the MAGNITUDE lever, same family, already in the armed string) releases all 7 of these frames -- 85 health is under a quarter of every bar in this corpus -- so while fieldsip is co-armed the presence defect is invisible. The masking is exact (7/7, asserted) and it is a COINCIDENCE OF DIRECTION, not a fix: fieldsip asks whether the sip is big enough to stay for, this asks whether the sip can be taken at all.
fieldsrc_ff_PREMISE_20260904.consequence_for_the_promote: EVERY wave that has bought (a) for stayfield/stayfield2 armed fieldsip in the same string. So on this population the measured behaviour is fieldsip's, not the hold's. Promoting stayfield/stayfield2 while REJECTING fieldsip would ship a configuration no wave has measured -- a hold on an uneatable item -- which is the pullcad/creeppull+pullbeat shape stated in advance instead of after: they are one atom in the direction 'hold without magnitude'. The other direction (promote fieldsip, reject the holds) is unaffected.

NON-VACUITY IS MEASURED, NOT ASSUMED: 203 of the 1012 live frames carry an item in slot 6 and 173 are past the 10-minute mark, so the two zeros are readings and not corpus blindness. Structural note: only 1 of the 24 source-carrying frames is past t=600 at all -- the situation predicate (HP 0.18..0.55, empty 1600 ring) lives almost entirely before the eat window opens in Turbo.

fieldsrc_ff_PREMISE_20260904.instrument_bug_bought_by_the_stand: The first run of the sweep reported all 7 slot reads OPEN on frames where slot 6 is EMPTY. Cause: `(op == 'occupied') and bOcc or not bOcc` -- Lua's and/or idiom returns the WRONG branch whenever the middle term is false, so a false bOcc fell through to `not bOcc` = true. The reading was 100% inverted on the load-bearing column and looked like an ordinary count. Rewritten as an explicit if, with the reason left in the source.

kvgetters2_20260904T.finding_2_cooldown_has_two_opposite_dire: The SAME 0 pushed two neighbouring guards in jmz_func.lua OPPOSITE ways, because it sat on both sides of `remaining >= ultCD / 2`. J.CanUseRefresherOrb: ultCD=0 makes the clause `remaining >= 0`, TRUE BY CONSTRUCTION -- the clause vacates and the guard is unconditionally permissive. J.CanUseRefresherShard: its extra `ultCD - remaining >= 2` becomes `remaining <= -2`, ARITHMETICALLY IMPOSSIBLE -- the branch was structurally dead in every fixture-driven run ever taken. J.GetMostUltimateCDUnit degenerates too: `GetCooldown() >= maxCD` is `0 >= 0` for everyone, so it returned the LAST eligible team member rather than the longest-cooldown one. MEASURED over 194 focus-hero frames carrying a non-passive ultimate: Orb passed on 36 frames at ultCD=0 and passes on 3 under the real cooldown (33 of 36 = 92% were pure vacuity); Shard passed on 0 and passes on 6. The Shard 0 is not 'no frame happened to match', it is the only value that expression could take.
kvgetters2_20260904T.migratable_lesson: A rule of thumb of the form 'an unspecced getter makes guards permissive' (or restrictive) is WRONG IN ONE OF ITS HALVES here whichever way it is written. The first batch's direction rule (a cast range stuck at 0 SHRINKS a ring => understates reach => manufactures 'this branch is not reached') does not transfer: carried over to the second batch it gets the sign backwards. What decides the sign is WHICH SIDE OF A COMPARISON the 0 lands on, and that has to be read per consumer. Backlog -87 predicted 'the direction may be the opposite of the last batch's' -- correct as a practice, wrong as a prediction: the cast-point half has NO direction (it is dormant) and the cooldown half has TWO.

mockscalar_PRICING_20260904.question: GH #492 给一个名字定了价(`GetExtrapolatedLocation`)。本轮问的是**整族**:`tests/mock/bot_api.lua` 的 `^Get -> 0` 兜底**不是一个默认值,是一句类型断言** ——「凡我没被告知的引擎 getter 都返回标量」。这句话在语料上覆盖多大,又在哪里是假的?
mockscalar_PRICING_20260904.domain: 109 fixture / **1012 活英雄帧**(与 §EF.1/§EH 同一语料同一分母)。**199,364 次真实单位上的 getter 探测**。shipped 代码在 `bots/` 下调用 **197** 个不同的 `Get*` 名字,其中 **166 个在全部 1012 帧上都由那条兜底回答**,只有 **5 个**被 mock 显式引开(`GetLocation` / `GetIncomingTrackingProjectiles` / `GetActualIncomingDamage` / `^GetNearby` / `handle_getters`)。⇒ **这句类型断言承载的是 fixture 路线的大部分,不是它的一个角落。**
mockscalar_PRICING_20260904.finding: **⭐ 一条 mock 默认值可以被「修好」成一台审查机,因为同一个文件里的两条默认值互相抵消,而它们之间的修复顺序是承重的。** `^Is/Has/Can/Was -> false` 挡在 `^Get -> 0` 前面。先修 `^Is` 那一半,不会浮出新读数,只会**静默删掉帧**(按 GH #492:两桶普查把抛错记成「量过了说不」)。先修 `^Get` 那一半做不到这件事。⇒ **两次修复有序:`^Get` 在 `^Is` 之前。** 这条顺序约束就是本轮的产出,它把总监手上 #492 的待裁事项从「要不要补一个方法」变成「补这一整份名单,而且要在动另一条前缀规则之前补」。
mockscalar_PRICING_20260904.mechanism: 四处 shipped 代码写的是同三行:`local nAbility = <unit>:GetCurrentActiveAbility()` / `if nAbility ~= nil` / `nAbility:GetBehavior()`。兜底答 **0**,而 **Lua 里 `0 ~= nil` 为真** ⇒ **那道 nil 守卫对这条默认值一次都没守住过**,下一行去索引一个数字。今天不出事,只是因为 `^Is -> false` 挡在前面。

midsupint_20260905.finding: **⭐ 主判据(立法级,可复用):把一个否定结果 ratchet 起来,而不是当结论存档 —— 因为解锁它的修复可能发生在别人的作用域里,而那一天你自己的 backlog 上没有任何东西在看。** §EH 把四条成员定价为「一条都作不了证」。解锁其中一条的修复是 **harness 的**(GH #492 补 mock 的 `GetExtrapolatedLocation`,总监,§EL),协同组 backlog 上没有任何一条会在那天注意到。`test_midsupmirror_checkability.lua` 的 `[ratchet]` 腿**替我举了手**,本轮才有这个工作单元。**同一张表如果只当结论存档,它会一直读作「四条」。**

outchan_PRICING_20260905.finding: **⭐ 主判据(立法级,可复用,超出本主题):「全文件没有这个 token」是一句关于文件的话,不是一句关于代码的话。** 守卫可以住在一次调用之内 —— 这里 `Think()` 的**第一条语句**就是 `if J.CanNotUseAction(bot) then return end`,而 `J.CanNotUseAction`(`jmz_func.lua:103`)的析取项里**就有** `or bot:IsChanneling()`。#511 的那一行加的是一个**同一帧上、更早、已经求过值**的析取项 ⇒ 落地它 = §EK 的 `argfix` 形状:**改了源码、过得了评审、与未修树逐位相同**。**⭐⭐ 而且它自己的帧证据反证它自己**:仓库里 `ability_capture` **唯一**的施法点(`mode_outpost_generic.lua:144`)就在那道守卫**下面** ⇒ 每一次被记录的施法,**按构造**都是 `bot:IsChanneling()` 已经为假的那一帧。这条推理**不依赖语料**,对 #511 那 53 次尝试同样成立。
outchan_PRICING_20260905.mechanism: **时序是反的,实测**:`MODIFIER_REMOVE` **先**发生,施法**后**发生,中位间隔 **0.1s**。28 个可定序的间隔里 **0 个**施法严格早于它本该解释的那次移除,**24 个**移除严格在先,**4 个**在 dump 的 0.1s 量化上并列(**登记为 UNDECIDABLE,不并进任何一侧**)。⇒ 重发是中断的**下游**,不是它的原因。再排掉本文件自己的三条放弃子句(`GetDesireHelper` 的「离塔 <600u 且视野内有敌人」、`WasRecentlyDamagedByAnyHero(5)`、`存活数 我方<敌方`):36 个中断瞬间里分别命中 **2 / 0 / 0** ⇒ **34/36 的中断在本文件里找不到任何理由**,模式从没停止过想要这座塔。剩下的活解释是**模式仲裁**:别的模式抢走一个 tick、它的命令掐断 channel,瞭望塔模式 0.1s 后重新胜出并重发。⇒ **杠杆是 `GetDesire()` 里的承诺(commitment),不是 `Think()` 里的守卫 —— 文件的另一头。**
outchan_PRICING_20260905.witness: `20260905_010205_slot7` **t=1349.9–1370.7,luna**:距塔 **140u**、hp **1.00 全程**、窗口内 **0 次**受击(`DAMAGE` 命中 0)、最近敌人 **≥2618u**(远在 1800u 视野外)、存活 **5v5 全程不变** —— 14 次施法、14 次 channel、**一次也没占下来**,而三条子句**一条都没真过**。第二例 `20260905_010226_slot3` t=1020.0–1025.6,axe:4 次施法,子句 (a) 在其中 **2** 次中断上**为真** —— 这一例是**留着当反真空的**(见 instrument)。

outchan_PRICING_20260905.instrument: `outchan_domain.py` 的每一条 0 都配了**能出非零的对照**,否则不作数:(1) `issuefix` 腿改成**实测**(施法时刻是否落在该施法者自己的 ADD..REMOVE 区间内),这个数**可以**非零 —— 非零就说明 #511 是对的、本裁定是错的;(2) 该腿自带 `issuefix_intervals`(区间重建了几个),因为**空区间列表报的 0 和真读数的 0 一模一样**;(3) 子句 (a) 的同一个估计量在**全部 58978 帧**上跑出 **19127** 非零;(4) axe 切片让子句 (a) 在**中断瞬间本身**上出 **2**,证明它不是「在中断瞬间结构上开不了口」。**⚠️ 一处自伤,当场收账**:本轮工具第一版的汇总行写着「every gap > 0」,而它自己下一行的分布里印着 **4 个 0** —— **结论与自己的读数矛盾**,已改成 before/tie/after 三分并把并列登记为 UNDECIDABLE。

cmcreepcap_20260905.star_main_judgement: ⭐ **方向由构造保证,而这一次是一个 NARROWING —— 前三根都是超集,这根是子集。** `dps*mult*duration <= 1200` 对每一级成立,4 级取等 ⇒ armed 放行的小兵集合是 shipped 的**严格子集**,arming 只能**减少**释放。所以负读数只能读作「那些小兵本来该冻」,**永远不能**读作「杠杆凭空多冻了一只」。⭐⭐ **而这个方向有一个前提,前提被写成了棘轮**:t25 行必须仍取 `{10, 0}`。另一半 `special_bonus_unique_crystal_maiden_1`(+1.0s 持续)会把 4 级上限抬到 1600,引擎把已学天赋折进 base 读数(GH #228)⇒ 方向当场翻成放宽。tests/test_cm_frostbite_creep_cap.lua §6 盯着那一行,它一动本文件的方向论证就红。**这是第一次把「方向论证的前提」而不是「方向本身」钉成断言。** 变异台的 **M4(duration 项 `+ 1`)** 就是这条:它读起来像**修正**(「把天赋算进去」),却把窄化变成放宽;抓住它的是 §3 的**两遍扫描**(先全梯度扫方向界、再逐级扫严格性),单遍循环会在低级的严格性上先断掉、**永远打不出那条方向失败的消息** —— 第一版就是这样,M4 当时记的是「RED 但消息不对 = 按 survived 处理」,如实登记。
cmcreepcap_20260905.change: bots/BotLib/hero_crystal_maiden.lua:新 `X.cm_GetFrostbiteCreepCap( hAbility )`(armed 时返回 `GetSpecialValueInt('damage_per_second') * GetSpecialValueInt('creep_multiplier') * GetSpecialValueFloat('duration')`,读到 `<= 0` **回落到出厂 1200**;否则逐字返回出厂 1200);X.ConsiderW 新增一个 `local nCreepCap = X.cm_GetFrostbiteCreepCap( abilityW )`,两处 `<= 1200` 改为 `<= nCreepCap`。血量下界(460/390/410/360)、`<= 1200` 之外的每一项判据、其余所有分支**一个字没动**。
cmcreepcap_20260905.direction_by_construction: armed 上限 <= shipped 上限,对每一级成立,4 级取等 ⇒ armed 是 shipped 的严格子集(NARROWING)。gate 关时逐字返回出厂字面量;shipped 表达式是函数的**最后一条语句**、armed 分支是唯一的绕道(GH #162 house rule),所以 gate-off 等价是结构性的。standalone,不与任何候选 id 合取(pullcad 陷阱;新文件 §6 有棘轮断言 IsSoakCandidate 在整份源码里只出现一次)。

cmcreepcap_20260905.real_frame_coverage: **分支 = 源码级覆盖,改动的那一项 = 真实帧覆盖,两句不许合并。** 整块 fixture 驱动不了:`bot:GetNearbyCreeps` 在 **10/10 个 CM 主体帧上、对两个队伍都返回空表**(§5 的两条断言各写一条,并用一个正文里带 npc_dota_creep_* 的 fixture 证明这个零是**loader 的不是语料的**);第二条独立堵点是该块自己的门与「有敌方小兵」在语料里交集为空(§5b,门只在 2/10 帧上开)。**但改动的那一项在真实句柄上读得出来**:10/10 帧解析出真的 crystal_maiden_frostbite 句柄,三个 KV 读数全部为活值(dps=100 / mult=4 / duration>0);等级直方图 **2->1 / 3->2 / 4->7**,shipped 上限 1200 vs armed 上限在 **3/10** 帧上不同(具名帧 f_113638_cm_chain_rescue:**shipped 1200 / armed 800**)。⚠️ 这 3/10 是**下界不是频率**:语料是 10 分钟封顶的对局切出来的(GH #108),对 1-6 级那一段结构性偏薄,而误差方向**不利于本改动**。定价走 queue hero-33,不走这份扫描。
cmcreepcap_20260905.negative_result_registered: **PROVEN-ZERO 这条线在焦点五里已经空了,逐站点读完的结论登记如下,后来的轮次不要再取它。** 今天重跑 tools/agent/ability_damage_census.py,焦点五仍有 5 个站点,但**三个是已落地修复自己的出厂回落腿**(`hero_zuus.lua:947` = `X.GetBoltRangedKillDamage` 里的 `nShipped`,本组今天 20:0xZ 刚写的;`hero_zuus.lua:1063` = `X.GetBoltKillHealthCap` 的最后一条语句;`hero_lion.lua:583` = `X.GetImpaleKillDamage` 的最后一条语句)—— 它们**按 GH #162 house rule 就该留在那里**,不是缺陷。**剩下的两个是没有消费者的死局部**:`hero_lion.lua:822`(X.ConsiderW)与 `hero_lion.lua:1009`(X.ConsiderE)各写着 `local nDamage = ability:GetAbilityDamage()`,而 `nDamage` 在这两个函数体内**再也没有被读过一次**(隔壁 X.ConsiderR 里另有一个同名局部,是另一个作用域)⇒ 既不是「杀死分支」也不是「放宽分支」,**删掉是零行为改动、留着是零行为影响**,本轮不动。⚠️ 它们**不在** `tests/test_dead_numeric_local_census.lua` 的域里 —— 那个普查按自己的 LIMIT (2) 只收 `local n<X> = <数字字面量>`,这两处右边是一次**调用**。要收编它得先加宽那个普查的域并重新量天花板,那是量具活、不是本组的主体配额,登记在此。
